groups.activity: pick Azima at a weapon milestone (day 100, 300, 500 or 700)
groups.meta: earliest possible day 100; worst case day 700

rows.label: Azima
rows.note: the day 100 pool is Azima, Zenistar or Zenith

conditions: Login days are cumulative, not consecutive; missing days only delays the milestone, nothing resets.
A picked weapon leaves the pool and the choice cannot be changed. Sigma & Octantis joins the pool from day 300.
bonuses: Arrives with its own weapon slot and an Orokin Catalyst pre-installed; no Foundry step.
Taking one weapon at each of days 100, 300, 500 and 700 gets all four, so the order does not matter for Mastery.

disclosures.title: replacement copy, not a shortcut
disclosures.body: Cephalon Simaris sells an Azima Blueprint for 100,000 standing, but only after you have claimed one from the Tribute. It gives no extra Mastery. The build is 30,000 credits, 4 Morphics, 450 Circuits, 500 Polymer Bundle and 2,750 Salvage, 24 hours.

disclosures.title: which to pick first
disclosures.body: Players who want one to use pick Zenith first for its infinite punch-through. The Azima is a solid early secondary with a huge magazine and ammo pool, but later secondaries outclass it.
